subject_uz: Maktabgacha ta'lim tashkilotida tarbiyalanuvchilar uchun issiq ovqat tashkil etish (autsorsing), 2026-yil noyabr-dekabr oylari

requirements.summary_uz: Taomnoma Ijtimoiy himoya milliy agentligi taqdim etadigan namunaviy taomnomaga mos bo'lishi va SanQvaN talablariga amal qilinishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The menu must follow the model menu supplied by the national social-protection agency and comply with the SanQvaN sanitary rules.
requirements.quote: Taomnoma: Ijtimoiy himoya milliy agentligi tomonidan taqdim etiladigan namunaviy taomnomaga mos ravishda

requirements.summary_uz: Ustama haq 15 foizdan kam va 16 foizdan ko'p bo'lmasligi kerak; narx qismi 30 ball bilan baholanadi.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor's mark-up must be between 15 and 16 percent; the price part carries 30 points.
requirements.quote: Taklif etiladigan ustama haqi miqdori l6 foizdan oshmasligi hamda 15 foizdan kam bo'lmasligi lozim

requirements.summary_uz: Avans oldingi oydagi haqiqiy xarajatlarning 30 foizi miqdorida to'lanadi, yakuniy hisob-kitob oy oxirida amalga oshiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: The advance is 30 percent of the previous month's actual costs; final settlement is made at the end of each month.
requirements.quote: buyurtmachi tomonidan awalgi oyda ovqatlanish uchun amalga oshirilgan haqiqiy xarajatlaming 30 foizi miqdorida oldindan to'lov (avans) amalga oshiriladi

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi kamida uch oylik shartnoma summasiga teng aylanma mablag'ga ega ekanini moliyaviy hujjatlar bilan tasdiqlaydi.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must prove working capital equal to at least three months of the contract sum with financial documents.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi kamida uch oylik shartnoma summasiga teng aylanma mablag'larga ega ekanligini moliyaviy hujjatlar bilan tasdiqlaydi

requirements.summary_uz: Ijrochi shartnoma summasining kamida 1 foizi miqdorida (taxminan 657 ming so'm) buyurtmachi muassasasiga investitsiya kiritishga kafolat xati beradi.
requirements.summary_en: The contractor must give a guarantee letter to invest at least 1 percent of the contract sum (about 657 thousand UZS) in the customer's facility.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi shartnoma umumiy summasining kamida 1 foizi miqdorida investitsiya kiritishga roziligi haqida kafolat xatini taqdim etadi.

requirements.summary_uz: Menyu va menyu-kalkulyatsiya hujjatlari SanQvaN ga mosligi uchun 20 ballgacha beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Up to 20 points are given for a menu and menu-costing documents that comply with SanQvaN.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi amaldagi SanQvaN talablariga muvofiq taomnoma, menyu-kalkulyatsiya, har bir taom bo‘yicha chiqish vazni, tarkibi, mahsulot sarfi

requirements.summary_uz: Oxirgi 3 yilda xizmat ko'rsatilgan tashkilotlar ro'yxati va kamida 5 ta tavsiyanoma uchun 15 ballgacha beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Up to 15 points depend on a list of organisations served in the last 3 years and at least 5 recommendation letters.
requirements.quote: Xizmat ko‘rsatgan tashkilotlardan kamida 5 ta tavsiyanoma ilova qilinadi.

requirements.summary_uz: Oshxona jihozlari, omborxona, sovitkich, transport, inventar va xodimlar mavjudligi uchun 20 ballgacha beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Up to 20 points are given for owning kitchen equipment, a warehouse, refrigeration, transport, inventory and staff.
requirements.quote: 20 ball – quyidagi barcha asosiy resurslar to‘liq mavjud bo‘lsa: oshxona/ishlab chiqarish jihozlari, omborxona, sovitkich uskunalari, transport vositalari, inventarlar hamda malakali xodimlar tarkibi.

requirements.summary_uz: Ruxsat etuvchi hujjatlar, sanitariya xulosalari va sertifikatlar soni bo'yicha ball beriladi (20 tadan ortiq bo'lsa 5 ball).
requirements.summary_en: Points depend on the number of permits, sanitary opinions and certificates submitted (5 points for more than 20).
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi faoliyat turi uchun talab etiladigan ruxsat etuvchi hujjatlar, sanitariya-epidemiologiya xulosalari, muvofiqlik sertifikatlari, sifat va xavfsizlikni tasdiqlovchi hujjatlarni taqdim etadi.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi xodimlari sanitariya kitobchasiga ega bo'lishi va tibbiy ko'rikdan o'tganligi hujjatlarini taqdim etishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must provide sanitary books and medical-check documents for its staff.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi xodimlari sanitariya kitobchasi va belgilangan tartibda tibbiy ko'rikdan o'tganligini tasdiqlovchi hujj atlami taqdim etadi.

flags.quote: Qish-bahor mavsumida asosiy turdagi oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarining kamida uch oylik zaxirasini shakllantirish va uni doimiy ravishda saqlab borishni ta'minlash
flags.explanation_uz: Xizmat muddati 2026-yil 1-noyabrdan 31-dekabrgacha, ya'ni ikki oy, lot boshlang'ich narxi esa 65 707 040 so'm. Shunga qaramay, kamida uch oylik asosiy oziq-ovqat zaxirasini yig'ish va doimiy saqlash talab qilinadi; bu taxminan 85 mln so'm tovar zaxirasi demak (16 foiz ustamasiz oziq-ovqat qiymatidan hisoblanganda) va u lotning umumiy narxidan ham yuqori, shu sababli kichik ta'minotchilar qatnashishi cheklanishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: The service runs for two months (1 November to 31 December 2026) and the lot start price is 65,707,040 UZS. Yet a standing reserve of at least three months of staple food is required, roughly 85 million UZS of stock (estimated from the food cost without the 16 percent mark-up), which is more than the whole lot price and may keep smaller suppliers out.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ijrochi shartnoma muddati davomida ovqatlantirish uzluksizligini ta'minlash uchun yetarli aylanma mablag' va saqlash joyiga ega bo'lishi lozim; oziq-ovqat zaxirasi hajmi xizmat muddatiga mutanosib (masalan, kamida 10 kunlik ehtiyoj) belgilansin.
flags.rewrite_en: The contractor must have enough working capital and storage to keep meals uninterrupted during the contract; the food reserve is set in proportion to the service period (for example at least 10 days of need).

flags.quote: 20 ball – quyidagi barcha asosiy resurslar to‘liq mavjud bo‘lsa: oshxona/ishlab chiqarish jihozlari, omborxona, sovitkich uskunalari, transport vositalari, inventarlar hamda malakali xodimlar tarkibi.
flags.explanation_uz: To'liq 20 ball ishtirokchining o'zida oshxona jihozlari, omborxona, sovitkich, transport va inventar bo'lishiga bog'langan. Texnik topshiriqning 7.1-bandiga ko'ra esa buyurtmachi oshxona xonalari, jihozlar va inventarni ijrochiga foydalanishga beradi, 11.8-bandda ham transport va ombor faqat "mavjud bo'lsa" ko'rsatiladi. Shu sababli resursi yo'q, lekin xizmatni bajara oladigan ishtirokchi 10-20 ball yo'qotishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: The full 20 points require the bidder to hold kitchen equipment, a warehouse, refrigeration, transport and inventory. Yet item 7.1 of the specification says the customer hands over kitchen premises, equipment and inventory, and item 11.8 asks for transport and storage only "if available". A bidder without its own assets that could still do the job may lose 10-20 points.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ball ishtirokchi xizmatni bajarish uchun zarur resurslarni (o'ziniki, ijaraga olingan yoki buyurtmachi taqdim etadiganlarni hisobga olgan holda) ta'minlay olishi, xususan transport va xodimlar mavjudligi bo'yicha berilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: Award points for the bidder's ability to secure the resources needed to perform the service (own, leased or supplied by the customer), in particular transport and staff.

flags.quote: Taklif etiladigan ustama haqi miqdori l6 foizdan oshmasligi hamda 15 foizdan kam bo'lmasligi lozim
flags.explanation_uz: Ustama haq 15 va 16 foiz oralig'ida bo'lishi shart, ammo narx qismi 30 ball bilan baholanadi: Ball = (eng past ustama / taklif etilgan ustama) x 30. Shu sababli narx bo'yicha farq ko'pi bilan 2 ball atrofida bo'ladi va 15 foizdan past ustama bilan ishlay oladigan ishtirokchi qatnasha olmaydi. Tanlash hujjatlarida esa faqat 16 foizdan yuqori takliflar rad etilishi yozilgan, pastki chegara haqida gap yo'q.
flags.explanation_en: The mark-up must lie between 15 and 16 percent, although the price part is worth 30 points by the formula (lowest mark-up / offered mark-up) x 30. Price can therefore change the result by only about 2 points, and a bidder able to work at a mark-up below 15 percent cannot take part. The tender document itself only says bids above 16 percent are rejected and states no lower limit.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ustama haq faqat yuqori chegara (16 foiz) bilan cheklansin yoki pastki chegara tanlash hujjatlarida ham aniq va asoslangan holda ko'rsatilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: Limit the mark-up only by an upper bound (16 percent), or state any lower bound clearly and with a reason in the tender document as well.

flags.quote: Xizmat ko‘rsatgan tashkilotlardan kamida 5 ta tavsiyanoma ilova qilinadi. Ma’lumotlar jadval shaklida tasdiqlangan bo‘lishi lozim. 15 ball – 5 tadan ko‘p tashkilot va tavsiyanomalari mavjud bo‘lsa.
flags.explanation_uz: Ikki oylik, 65 707 040 so'mlik xizmat uchun oxirgi 3 yilda 5 tadan ko'p tashkilotga xizmat ko'rsatgan va tavsiyanoma olgan ishtirokchi 15 ball oladi, 1-2 ta tashkilotli ishtirokchi esa atigi 1 ball. Yangi yoki kichik ijrochilar 14 ballgacha yo'qotadi, bu esa texnik qismda hal qiluvchi farq bo'lishi mumkin.
flags.explanation_en: For a two-month service worth 65,707,040 UZS, a bidder with more than 5 served organisations and recommendation letters in the last 3 years gets 15 points, while one with 1-2 organisations gets only 1 point. New or small contractors can lose up to 14 points, which may be decisive in the technical part.
flags.rewrite_uz: Oxirgi 3 yilda bolalar yoki ta'lim muassasalarida ovqatlantirish xizmatini ko'rsatgan kamida 1 ta shartnoma mavjudligi tasdiqlansa, to'liq ball berilsin; tavsiyanomalar soni bo'yicha keskin farq qo'llanilmasin.
flags.rewrite_en: Award full points if at least one catering contract for children's or educational institutions in the last 3 years is documented; avoid a steep scale based on the number of recommendation letters.

Xodimlarning sanitariya kitobchalari va tibbiy ko'rik hujjatlari
Ishtirokchi blankasida kafolat xati, halollik majburiyati arizasi va texnik kafolat xati (2-4 shakllar)
Davlat ro'yxatidan o'tganlik guvohnomasi, nizom va rahbar tayinlanganligi to'g'risidagi hujjatlar
Affillangan shaxslar va manfaatlar to'qnashuvi bo'yicha ma'lumot
